name: Pattaya
tagline: Bangkok's beach city of temples, islands and nightlife
summary: Pattaya is Thailand's closest big beach resort to Bangkok. Beyond its famous nightlife, it has the astonishing all-wood Sanctuary of Truth, island boat trips to Koh Larn, floating markets, theme parks and a breezy seafront.
seasonNote: November to February is dry and breezy. March to May is hot; the rainy season brings afternoon showers.
arrival: About 2 hours by road from Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport; U-Tapao Airport is 40 minutes south.
gettingAround: Baht-bus songthaews loop the main roads for 10 baht; Grab for longer trips.
cashTip: Carry baht for street food, songthaews and markets; cards work in malls and hotels.
foodTip: Seafood at Naklua and Jomtien, and som tam from street stalls.
buyTip: Night markets like Thepprasit for clothes and snacks.
baseArea: Jomtien or Naklua for calm; Central Pattaya for nightlife

items.name: Sanctuary of Truth
items.summary: A vast seaside temple carved entirely from wood, still under construction.
items.expect: Hard hats in work zones; dress modestly.
